symbols.concern_evidence: Structural bridge; semantic effects belong to dynamically selected near callees.
symbols.contract: Far entry in main code frame. CALL AX invokes a near target in the same CS, then RETF returns to the outer far caller. Requires AX to name valid main-frame near code that returns with a balanced stack. No register, segment or flag marshalling: all callee effects pass through. During near callee entry SP is two bytes below bridge-entry SP; normal outer return advances entry SP by4. Stack-depth and asynchronous safety depend on callees/environment. This is original ASM control-flow glue, not a reconstructed C adapter.
evidence: 0F7F has43 far calls through8D8B and one through8D8E in current decoded graph.
Examples:0F7F:028F loadsAX=5DB2 before0292 crossing;0153 loadsBP=5401 before0156 crossing. Targets are not one fixed shared service.
